record.title: Doctoral Degree In Education in London 2027
record.longDescription: Doctoral Degree In Education The Doctoral Degree in Education equips learners with in-depth knowledge and analytical capabilities to address complex challenges in education and business. Participants explore advanced research methods alongside core disciplines such as contemporary education, financial, and marketing management. Graduates will be prepared to drive policy change, lead organisations, and contribute to academic and practical educational advancements. Upon completion of the program, students should be able to: Demonstrate the ability to design and apply qualitative and quantitative research methodologies to investigate complex issues in educational and business contexts. Critically analyse and evaluate contemporary issues in education within local, national, and global contexts. Evaluate and apply financial strategies to optimise educational institutions and organisations' budgeting, investment, and funding decisions. Develop and assess strategic marketing plans to promote educational services and address the needs of various stakeholders and learners. Critically examine ethical dilemmas and integrate socially responsible practices into organisational policies and leadership decisions. Analyse and interpret economic theories and policies to understand their impact on education systems and organisational sustainability. Apply leadership models to influence positive change, enhance team performance, and navigate complex challenges within educational institutions. Employ data-driven and ethical decision-making models to resolve strategic issues and improve operational efficiency in educational and business settings.
record.courseDetails:
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of eight modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper)Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.Advanced Research Methods:This module develops advanced skills in formulating research questions, selecting methodologies, and analyzing data. Learners gain expertise in producing rigorous, evidence-based research to inform strategic decisions.Contemporary Issues In Education:This module focuses on critically examining current challenges, reforms, and innovations shaping education systems globally. It encourages learners to explore the social, political, and technological forces influencing educational theory, policy, and practice.Financial Management:Learners examine financial planning, investment analysis, and funding models within educational and non-profit institutions. The module covers budgeting, risk assessment, and financial performance metrics. It prepares learners to make sound fiscal decisions that align with long-term goals.Marketing Management:This module provides insights into market research, branding, and strategic communication in educational contexts. Learners will design campaigns tailored to institutional goals and learner needs.Business Ethics and Social Responsibility:Learners explore ethical theories, corporate responsibility, and stakeholder analysis in the education sector. The module fosters ethical awareness and promotes values-based governance.Economic Theory and Policy:The module examines classical and modern economic theories in the context of public policy and education systems. Learners analyze policy impacts on access, equity, and institutional funding.Leadership in Organizations:This module investigates transformational, transactional, and situational leadership frameworks. Learners assess how leadership styles influence culture, performance, and innovation.Managerial Decision Making:The module explores models of rational, bounded, and intuitive decision-making. Emphasis is placed on strategic, ethical, and collaborative approaches to solving problems.Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for 10 to 12 Months. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.

Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.

blocks.text: Entry Requirements

Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over five years of managerial and/or business experience Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over eight years of managerial and/or business experience
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
Workshops
Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.

Weekly write-up webinars and monthly supervisor meetings will be held to offer better coordination between the student and the supervisor and achieve optimal professionalism in writing the research report.

There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

Doctoral Degree In Education The Doctoral Degree in Education equips learners with in-depth knowledge and analytical capabilities to address complex challenges in education and business. Participants explore advanced research methods alongside core disciplines such as contemporary education, financial, and marketing management. Graduates will be prepared to drive policy change, lead organisations, and contribute to academic and practical educational advancements. Upon completion of the program, students should be able to: Demonstrate the ability to design and apply qualitative and quantitative research methodologies to investigate complex issues in educational and business contexts. Critically analyse and evaluate contemporary issues in education within local, national, and global contexts. Evaluate and apply financial strategies to optimise educational institutions and organisations' budgeting, investment, and funding decisions. Develop and assess strategic marketing plans to promote educational services and address the needs of various stakeholders and learners. Critically examine ethical dilemmas and integrate socially responsible practices into organisational policies and leadership decisions. Analyse and interpret economic theories and policies to understand their impact on education systems and organisational sustainability. Apply leadership models to influence positive change, enhance team performance, and navigate complex challenges within educational institutions. Employ data-driven and ethical decision-making models to resolve strategic issues and improve operational efficiency in educational and business settings.
Course Details
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of eight modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper)Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.Advanced Research Methods:This module develops advanced skills in formulating research questions, selecting methodologies, and analyzing data. Learners gain expertise in producing rigorous, evidence-based research to inform strategic decisions.Contemporary Issues In Education:This module focuses on critically examining current challenges, reforms, and innovations shaping education systems globally. It encourages learners to explore the social, political, and technological forces influencing educational theory, policy, and practice.Financial Management:Learners examine financial planning, investment analysis, and funding models within educational and non-profit institutions. The module covers budgeting, risk assessment, and financial performance metrics. It prepares learners to make sound fiscal decisions that align with long-term goals.Marketing Management:This module provides insights into market research, branding, and strategic communication in educational contexts. Learners will design campaigns tailored to institutional goals and learner needs.Business Ethics and Social Responsibility:Learners explore ethical theories, corporate responsibility, and stakeholder analysis in the education sector. The module fosters ethical awareness and promotes values-based governance.Economic Theory and Policy:The module examines classical and modern economic theories in the context of public policy and education systems. Learners analyze policy impacts on access, equity, and institutional funding.Leadership in Organizations:This module investigates transformational, transactional, and situational leadership frameworks. Learners assess how leadership styles influence culture, performance, and innovation.Managerial Decision Making:The module explores models of rational, bounded, and intuitive decision-making. Emphasis is placed on strategic, ethical, and collaborative approaches to solving problems.Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for 10 to 12 Months. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.

English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
Workshops
Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.

Weekly write-up webinars and monthly supervisor meetings will be held to offer better coordination between the student and the supervisor and achieve optimal professionalism in writing the research report.

There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

evidence.heading: courseDetails
evidence.text:
Course Details
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of eight modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper)Segment 1:
Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.Advanced Research Methods:This module develops advanced skills in formulating research questions, selecting methodologies, and analyzing data. Learners gain expertise in producing rigorous, evidence-based research to inform strategic decisions.Contemporary Issues In Education:This module focuses on critically examining current challenges, reforms, and innovations shaping education systems globally. It encourages learners to explore the social, political, and technological forces influencing educational theory, policy, and practice.Financial Management:Learners examine financial planning, investment analysis, and funding models within educational and non-profit institutions. The module covers budgeting, risk assessment, and financial performance metrics. It prepares learners to make sound fiscal decisions that align with long-term goals.Marketing Management:This module provides insights into market research, branding, and strategic communication in educational contexts. Learners will design campaigns tailored to institutional goals and learner needs.Business Ethics and Social Responsibility:Learners explore ethical theories, corporate responsibility, and stakeholder analysis in the education sector. The module fosters ethical awareness and promotes values-based governance.Economic Theory and Policy:The module examines classical and modern economic theories in the context of public policy and education systems. Learners analyze policy impacts on access, equity, and institutional funding.Leadership in Organizations:This module investigates transformational, transactional, and situational leadership frameworks. Learners assess how leadership styles influence culture, performance, and innovation.Managerial Decision Making:The module explores models of rational, bounded, and intuitive decision-making. Emphasis is placed on strategic, ethical, and collaborative approaches to solving problems.Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:
Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for 10 to 12 Months. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.

evidence.heading: entryRequirements
evidence.text:
Entry Requirements
Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in Education. Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over five years of managerial and/or business experience Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over eight years of managerial and/or business experience
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:
The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
